## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A one-fascicle anonymous Esoteric ritual manual for the practice of **Śākyamuni** in the *vajra-eka-yāna* (Vajra-One-Vehicle) tradition — i.e., the cosmic-Esoteric form of the historical Buddha as integrated with the Vajra-mandalic framework.

**Abstract**

The text presents the Esoteric framework for Śākyamuni-practice — the identification of the historical Buddha (in his *nirmāṇakāya*) with his cosmic *dharmakāya* expression in the Vajradhātu mandala. The *yīshèng* (One-Vehicle) doctrine of the *Saddharmapuṇḍarīka* tradition is here integrated with the Vajra-mandalic framework. The text is anonymously transmitted and conventionally dated to the late Táng period.
